Findings and their default severities (fixed in code, not configurable; the summary lists high and medium):
  takeover              dns-nxdomain          high    a CNAME dangles (NXDOMAIN) into a provider whose names anyone can claim
  takeover              http-fingerprint      high    a provider-hosted name serves the page an unclaimed resource serves
  takeover              storage-missing       high    a bucket or account the in-scope CNAME or a page asset names does not exist
  takeover              storage-missing-link  low     a missing bucket that is only the target of a plain link
  storage               listable              high    an attributed bucket whose contents anyone can list
  storage               public                medium  an attributed bucket with an object anyone can fetch, not listable
  storage               exists                low     an attributed bucket that exists and is private
  storage-unattributed  listable              low     a guessed bucket nothing in scope references, listable
  storage-unattributed  public                low     a guessed bucket nothing in scope references, with a public object
  sensitive-paths       <path>                medium  a sensitive path answered with its expected signature; the entry's severity, default medium
  email                 spf-all-plus          high    SPF ends in +all (or a bare all): anyone may send as the domain
  email                 spf-missing           medium  no SPF record
  email                 spf-all-neutral       medium  SPF ends in ?all
  email                 spf-invalid           medium  several SPF records, or an include that cannot be resolved
  email                 spf-lookups           low     SPF needs more than 10 DNS lookups
  email                 dmarc-missing         medium  no DMARC record
  email                 dmarc-none            low     DMARC policy is none
  email                 no-mx-spf             low     no MX (or a null MX) and no v=spf1 -all record
  email                 mta-sts-missing       low     a root with a mail host does not publish exactly one MTA-STS policy record (_mta-sts)
  ports                 risky-port            medium  a port on the risky list (RDP, SMB, Telnet, databases, ...) is open; low while only Shodan reports it
  certificates          expired               medium  the certificate has expired
  certificates          expiring              low     the certificate expires within --cert-expiry-days
  certificates          hostname-mismatch     low     the certificate does not name the probed host (not for an IP literal or a host on shared provider infrastructure)
  certificates          legacy-tls            low     the service negotiated TLS 1.0 or 1.1 (an old version offered alongside a newer one is not seen)
  certificates          self-signed           low     the certificate is self-signed
  web-posture           missing-hsts          low     an HTTPS service's first response has no Strict-Transport-Security header
  web-posture           insecure-cookie       low     a cookie set over HTTPS lacks Secure
  web-posture           directory-listing     low     the service's page is an automatic directory listing (Index of /)
  web-posture           version-disclosure    low     a Server or X-Powered-By header carries a version (Apache/2.4.41)
  origin-exposure       confirmed             medium  a hostname behind a CDN or WAF is also served directly by an address nyx may contact, which answers for it
  origin-exposure       possible              low     an address that may be the origin of a hostname behind a CDN or WAF, found from its history or a sibling and not confirmed
  eol-software          eol                   medium  a web technology or banner version is past the end of security support of its release cycle; low for a distribution build or a version only Shodan reports
  eol-software          eol-approaching       low     the end of security support of the release cycle is within --eol-warn-days
